description: This 3D model depicts a minimalist pendant light fixture designed for ceiling installation. It features a light blue cylindrical ceiling mount with vertical slotted details, from which a thin rod or cable extends downwards. At the end of this suspension, there's a central light blue cylindrical body that branches out to support three individual light heads. Each light head consists of a light purple-grey ring-like structure, possibly housing a light bulb, and is angled slightly outwards, suggesting multi-directional illumination. The overall design is clean and geometric, emphasizing functionality and modern aesthetics.
